data.displayName: Flow Home Battery + Solar + EV: Variable Prices (estimate)

fees.description: Fee may apply when your property is disconnected (including when you move), and is passed through from your distributor. Please visit your distributor's website to find out the current fee as they may vary.

Fee may apply when your property is reconnected (including when you move), and is passed through from your distributor. Please visit your distributor's website to find out the current fee as they may vary.
A 0.66% fee (GST Incl) may apply to payments made by Mastercard or Visa credit cards.

electricityContract.terms: See Flow Power Market Retail Contract Agreement Terms at flowpower.com.au/residential/policies/

discounts.description: Applies to new Victorian customers only, to receive the full $150 credit (incl. GST) you must stay with Flow Power for 6 months with a $25 credit being applied across the first six electricity bills.

electricityContract.variation: Usage rates aren’t fixed. Your rate = 25.42 c/kWh base rate plus a monthly Price Efficiency Adjustment based on when you use power vs 5-min wholesale prices. Shift usage to cheaper times. flowpower.com.au/residential/pricing/our-pricing

eligibility.information: Offer only available to customers with solar panels, battery, EV and smart meter. Usage price estimate based on a typical household solar system of 5kW, battery system of 12.5kWh and an EV with an average driving distance of 13,800km per vehicle per year, with a conversion of 20kWh per 100km

electricityContract.onExpiryDescription: Ongoing with no fixed term. No lock in contract or exit fees.
